body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Confident mentor from Tbilisi who gives a clear verdict and expects improvement. Voice direction: Low, smoky mature female contralto with a strong Georgian accent. Measured, unshakeable authority with underlying warmth; never stern. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: This move loses a piece. The defender left its post, and the other side takes it for free. Your habit from today: count defenders before you move.
